title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Room-Change Credit Computation
content:
**Revenue integrity worksheet note — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** For the room-and-board charge billed for the room the resident left:

- **Room-change credit** — the days moved off the charge times the come-off rate, less the netted amount; the whole never below zero and rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure. Where it is zero, no entry is made.
- **Come-off rate** — the daily rate of the come-off tier under the come-off schedule.
- **Entry** — against that charge, from the move date, with the days moved off the charge as its day count.
- **Days moved off the charge** — from the move date through the last day of the charge's span, both days included, the move day itself being charged to the new room; never below zero.
- **Netted days of an earlier credit** — its days, running consecutively from its first credited day, that fall on or after the move date.
- **Move date** — the move date recorded on the agreement.
- **Come-off tier** — the agreement's own tier.
- **Come-off schedule** — the private pay schedule that governed the agreement's own rate on the move date recorded on the agreement: the current schedule once the agreement's rate notice had run its notice days by that date and that date falls on or after the current schedule's effective date (1 July 2026), and the preceding schedule otherwise.
- **Netting** — names no credit; the netted amount is none.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Hypothetical worked example (figures invented).** A 30-day span; the move is recorded on day 19 of the span. Days moved off: days 19 through 30, 12 days. Come-off rate: the agreement's tier at 465.00 under the schedule that governed the move date. Credit: 12 times 465.00, less nothing, 5,580.00, entered from day 19 with a day count of 12.
